name: VVTX GBP stablecoin
oneLiner: VVTX's pre-launch sterling stablecoin programme combines proposed 1:1 liquid-asset backing with a proprietary UK Layer-1, wallet and card.
collateral: Proposed full 1:1 GBP backing with high-quality liquid assets. Reserve composition, custodians, segregation and insolvency terms, and dated independent reserve attestation remain undisclosed; the reserve-attestation heading links no retrieved report.
pegMechanism: VVTX Limited proposes a 1:1 GBP-pegged stablecoin with controlled mint and burn on a purpose-built UK Layer-1, accessed through a custodial wallet and planned debit card. Public-holder direct redemption terms, eligibility, fees, minima, settlement timing and capacity are unpublished. Card spending does not establish issuer par redemption.
launchPhaseDetail: FCA selected VVTX for its stablecoin sandbox on 25 February 2026. The issuer still invites a waitlist for its GBP stablecoin, custodial wallet and card, describing a proprietary UK Layer-1 with unpublished technical identifiers. GBP-VVTX is an editorial display label following ticker-less programme precedents, not an issuer-published token ticker. Sandbox selection does not establish final stablecoin authorization; no production contracts, decimals, public price/circulation or launch date are verified.

milestones.title: FCA selects VVTX for stablecoin sandbox
milestones.description: Testing programme, not full authorization or a public token launch.
